description: This file contains a class 'AnalysisOrchestratorService' that coordinates various parts of a resume analysis and job matching pipeline. It interacts with multiple repositories and services to perform ATS checks, skills extraction, suggestion creation, and recommendation generation, often asynchronously, and manages analysis lifecycle states.

classes.name: AnalysisOrchestratorService
classes.description: Coordinates analysis pipeline: ATS checks, skills extraction, suggestions, and recommendations.

methods.name: None _run_analysis_pipeline(self, analysis_id: int, user_id: int, text: Optional[str])
methods.description: Executes the core analysis logic asynchronously, updating statuses, storing findings, extracting skills, and generating recommendations.

methods.name: int start_analysis_for_resume( self, user_id: int, resume_id: int, text: Optional[str], background_tasks: BackgroundTasks )
methods.description: Creates an analysis record and schedules the analysis pipeline to run as a background task.

methods.name: int analyze_text(self, user_id: int, text: Optional[str], target_role: Optional[str] = None)
methods.description: Performs a synchronous analysis of provided text, running the core pipeline and storing results.

methods.name: None _create_recommendations(self, analysis_id: int, user_id: int, candidate_skills: List[str])
methods.description: Generates job recommendations based on candidate skills and user preferences.
